subject: Post-signature sprint playbook & MAP: canary, migration, training cadence
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature sprint playbook & MAP: canary, migration, training cadence

Emma — congratulations again on completing signatures. I outlined a concise mutual action plan (attached) that embeds the rollout, canary, migration, and training milestones into a two-week sprint cadence. Goal: get the first production canary serving live with sampling and rollback controls within 6 weeks, and staff training completed by week 8.

High-level asks for this week:
- Confirm the two-week blackout windows for your infra team (we need at least one 4-hour maintenance window during week 2).
- Who on your side will own the pilot acceptance checklist? (I put Alden as primary in the draft)
- Please review the attached Evaluation_Plan_BlueHarbor_v1.pdf — key success criteria live on p.2 (latency, accuracy on 10 eval prompts, token cost targets).

Attached: MPA_BlueHarbor_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), Evaluation_Plan_BlueHarbor_v1.pdf, canary-deployment-checklist.md

Next steps: if we hear confirmation by Friday 10/30 we’ll lock the sprint and send calendar blocks for the training sessions.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alden Park <alden.park@blueharborhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature sprint playbook & MAP: canary, migration, training cadence

Thanks Mina — and excited to get moving. Quick answers: Alden will own the pilot acceptance checklist (confirmed). We can give you a 4-hour maintenance window on Fri 11/12 between 02:00–06:00 PT (our infra lead is on call then).

We skimmed the evaluation plan — the accuracy thresholds look reasonable. A couple of asks from our security team before go-live:
- Can you confirm log retention settings (we need 90 days) and audit export format?
- Will the canary include telemetry for per-route token counts?

We’ll review the attached MPA and come back with inline comments by Thursday EOD. For now please tentatively schedule training sessions the week of 11/8.

Best,
Emma
Director, Product Ops | BlueHarbor Health
emma.jones@blueharborhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: internal: scheduling & resource asks for BlueHarbor MAP

Mina / Vivek — looping you in with notes from Emma. Two immediate ops items I want to confirm on our side before we reply with the full calendar: 

1) Canary configuration: Vivek — can you validate the canary profile in the attached checklist? Specifically we will:
   - Route 2% of production traffic for 48 hours,
   - Enable per-route KPIs and token telemetry,
   - Auto-fallback to baseline model on error >0.5% 5xxs.

2) Audit & logs: Ben — security wants audit export in newline-delimited JSON and retention at 90 days. Can your team enable an S3 export with lifecycle policy?

I’ll draft a brief reply to Emma confirming our answers and propose exact training slots (Tues/Wed 11/9–11/10 10:00–12:00 PT).

-Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@blueharborhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature sprint playbook & MAP: canary, migration, training cadence

Emma — quick confirmation from infra/security:
- We will deliver audit exports in NDJSON, S3 bucket with 90-day lifecycle; I’ll send the bucket name and IAM grant details in a separate email once provisioning completes.
- Per-route token telemetry will be available in the console and exported to your metrics endpoint (we’ll include a sample payload format).

I also attached a stubbed canary-deployment-checklist.md to this thread for your review (see note at top about rollback play).

Attachments referenced: canary-deployment-checklist.md (text) — contains the step-by-step runbook and emergency rollback commands.

Let us know if the proposed training times work; we’ll reserve the instructor slot.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alden Park <alden.park@blueharborhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature sprint playbook & MAP: canary, migration, training cadence

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming the following so we can lock dates:
- Alden will be pilot owner and will review the MPA spreadsheet by EOD Monday 11/1.
- Maintenance window Fri 11/12 02:00–06:00 PT is confirmed.
- Training slots 11/9 & 11/10 10:00–12:00 PT are OK for our product and support leads.
- Audit export format and 90-day retention accepted; Alden will coordinate S3 access with Ben.
- We reviewed the evaluation plan and will provide a short test set (10 prompts + expected labels) by 11/3.

Next step: once Alden posts inline comments to the MPA I’ll mark the ticket in HubSpot and we can send final calendar invites. Excited to get the canary running.

Thanks all — Emma
